messages:
Liam: quick one — where's the saved search (or dashboard) for kv-cache misses p95 / rate for gen routes in ap-sg for org=acme and model=gen-xl? need it for a postmortem and want to tune alerts.
Maya: we have a saved discover view, iirc. try this query in LogSearch/Kibana:
```
service:inference AND route:gen* AND org:acme AND model:gen-xl AND region:ap-sg AND kv_cache_miss:true
```
then group by @route, @model, @org and use p95 for latency or count() for miss rate. saved search name: ops/kv-miss/acme-ap-sg-gen-xl (under Saved Discover).
Maya: dashboard link (prod): https://logsearch.redwood.internal/app/discover#saved=ops%2Fkv-miss%2Facme-ap-sg-gen-xl — if the link 403s, you might need the vpn or the SSO access.
Tom: for alerting, what's been noisy historically? we want to avoid noisy pagers on small spikes.
Maya: yep — noisy when canaries roll or during brief infra flaps. we do two-tier alerts: 1) warning (channel-only) if 5m rate > 2% and absolute count > 50; 2) pager if sustained (3 consecutive 5m) and rate > 5% OR p95 latency > 500ms.
Maya: sample saved alert condition (LogSearch alerting):
```
query: service:inference AND route:gen* AND org:acme AND model:gen-xl AND region:ap-sg AND kv_cache_miss:true
condition: (count() / total_requests) > 0.02 AND count() > 50 over 5m
notify: #sre-ops, override: oncall
```
Jia: small tweak — exclude canary routes (they end with "-canary") so add `NOT route:*-canary` to the query to reduce noise during rollouts.
Tom: good call. also add `env:prod` if you only want prod signals.
Liam: thanks — can someone create the saved search (if it doesn't exist) and add it to the inference ops dashboard? i'll include the link in the postmortem.
Maya: i'll create the saved search and dashboard tile in ~15m and tag the postmortem doc. assigning: @sre-oncall for the pager policy review.
sre-bot: saved search `ops/kv-miss/acme-ap-sg-gen-xl` created by Maya at 2123456798. dashboard tile added to `Inference / Health / KV Cache`.
Liam: perfect. leaving this thread open for alerting tweaks — i'll follow up with the postmortem note once i have numbers. :thumbsup:
Tom: added a snippet you can paste into alert form: `expr = sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total{org="acme",model="gen-xl",region="ap-sg",env="prod",route!~".*-canary"}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{org="acme",model="gen-xl",region="ap-sg",env="prod"}[5m]))` — alert if > 0.05 for 15m.
Maya: thanks — i'll start with warning thresholds and we can iterate.
Liam: appreciated, folks.
